chapter_mission: Open the climax with Torin's refusal, Desh laying the field, and Ben discovering the way the nodes now register to him.
chapter_turn: Ben reaches the moment he has been building toward and fails the first version of it because he still tries to control what has to be shared.

scene_plan.purpose: Ben's last appeal to Torin lands as affection and refusal across distance.
Use the walk through Desh's array to give Ben the node-sense and Veraine's design signature without explanation.
At mid-valley, let the resonance fail under Ben's control.

relationship_turns.to: final exchange — Torin's use of 'Ben' across the valley carries warmth that makes the refusal worse. He is not rejecting Ben; he is rejecting Ben's approach while admiring his character. The relationship ends in affection

failed first attempt — the resonance resists Ben's instinct to command it. His Lie's last stand is structural, not psychological: he tries to make three incompatible traditions combine by force of will, and they will not. The book's thesis gets one scene of failure before it gets its answer
fellow notes — both are present, both are committed, both are reachable through the Force, and both are waiting for Ben to stop leading so they can begin. The discordance is not their fault

nodes as Weave-registerable voices — per B3 plant, Ben's resonance-adjacent Force-sense has registered the containment nodes as load-bearing points in the Weave; the sensory capacity is new, unnamed, and will carry the climactic legibility in Ch 25-26

material mind — per W2 evidence-of-passage beat 5, Ben has now walked through Veraine's design signature and felt it under his feet. The climactic environment is her; he will fight the architecture of her thinking for the rest of the book

exit_vector: Three hands linked, Force discordant, sweat and strain, Veraine's ritual building, Torin's void expanding, Desh running the guarded route between amplification nodes and not yet visible to Ben except through the Weave-registerable voices of the nodes themselves. The chapter closes on the inside of a failure in motion. Ch25 is one step away — the step Ben has not yet taken.
notes: This chapter must close on failure. Let the environment teach Ben what the next chapter will ask him to hold.
